title: Expedition 33 Verso Build - Best Skills & Strategy
description: Complete Verso build guide for Expedition 33 covering the Perfection system, best skills, Gaulteram/Dualiso/Sireso weapons, and build strategies.

sections.title: Verso Overview & Perfection System
sections.content:
The enigmatic Verso joins your expedition at the start of Act 2. His history is unknown, but his combat prowess is undeniable. Verso is one of the strongest DPS characters in the game, capable of both devastating personal damage and powerful team support.

Perfection Rank System

As Verso attacks, dodges, parries, and uses skills, he accumulates Perfection. After gathering enough, his Rank increases through the tiers:

RankEffect
DBase damage (starting rank)
CSlight damage increase
BModerate damage increase
AHigh damage, skill bonuses begin (Powerful lasts 5 turns)
SMaximum damage multiplier, full skill bonuses unlocked

Critical rule: Taking damage reduces Verso's Rank. This means defensive mastery (Parrying and Dodging) is essential for Verso players. If you can't reliably avoid hits, Verso's damage potential drops significantly.

Pro tip: Critical hits grant bonus Perfection. Stacking Luck and Crit Pictos helps Verso reach S-Rank faster and maintain it longer.

sections.title: Best Skills
sections.content:
Light Skills (Recommended)

  • Light Holder: Verso's premier Rank builder with solid damage. Functionally costs only 2 AP (great efficiency). Perfect for pushing from A-Rank to S-Rank.
  • Phantom Stars: One of Verso's strongest S-Rank skills. AP efficient, can Break enemies, deals high AoE damage. Your go-to at S-Rank.
  • Follow Up: At S-Rank, extremely efficient with Free Aim to apply Burn/Mark. Regularly hits the 9,999 damage cap.
  • Speed Burst: Excellent damage scaling with Agility. Best with high-Agility weapons and Speed Pictos.
  • Perfect Break: Solid AoE Break ability. Hefty AP cost but can break weaker enemies while pushing toward S-Rank.

Physical Skills

  • End Bringer: Massive damage against stunned enemies. Can also delay enemy turns — use after Breaking a boss.
  • Berserk Slash: Only worthwhile after obtaining Painted Power (removes damage cap). Before that, safer moves reach 9,999 anyway.

Weapon Skills

  • Ascending Assault: Starts weak but builds up damage with each use. Excellent for extended boss fights where Verso stays at S-Rank.
  • Assault Zero: Solid Rank builder using your weapon's element. Less damage than Light Holder but cheaper AP cost.
  • Marking Shot: Sets up massive damage from other party members. Essential in support-oriented builds.
  • Strike Storm: Incredible with high Crit at S-Rank. QTE requires 2 rapid button presses — if failed, the attack doesn't execute.

Utility Skills

  • Powerful: Apply damage buff to entire party. At A-Rank, lasts 5 turns — outstanding support value.
  • Perfect Recovery: Strong heal that also removes negative status effects. Great self-sustain.
  • Purification: One of the few offensive dispels. Essential against bosses that stack positive buffs.

Gradient Attacks

  • Angel's Eyes: Hits hard and gives Verso a second chance if he falls. Excellent Gradient 3 skill (unlocked at Esquie Relationship 7).

sections.title: Recommended Weapons
sections.content:
Verso's three signature weapons each enable a completely different playstyle. Choose based on your preferred role.

Gaulteram — Standard DPS

Provides an elemental damage type different from Verso's natural Physical/Light skills, allowing him to exploit more weaknesses. The straightforward choice for maximum personal damage output.

Playstyle: Build to S-Rank with Light Holder and Assault Zero, then unleash Phantom Stars and Strike Storm for massive burst. Keep Rank high through skilled Parrying.

Dualiso — Double Turn Build

Dropped by the Dualliste boss in Forgotten Battlefield (Level 23 Required boss). Has a low base damage coefficient but effectively grants two turns in one cycle.

How it works: The weapon's passive gives Verso a second action. Use the first turn to build Rank with multi-hit attacks, then spend the second turn on high-damage finishers like Phantom Stars.

Key Pictos/Luminas: Enfeebling Attack, Combo Attack I, Energising Attack I, Greater Defenceless. These maximize the value of each double-turn cycle.

Sireso — Support Build

Obtained from Axon Sirene. This weapon fundamentally changes Verso's role: he no longer gains personal damage from Rank. Instead, his Rank provides a damage bonus to ALL allies.

Playstyle: Build to S-Rank using multi-hit attacks, then focus entirely on utility — Powerful (party buff), Marking Shot (setup for DPS allies). Your damage comes from empowering teammates rather than personal attacks.

Best for: Boss fights where another character (Maelle, Sciel) deals the primary damage. Verso becomes the ultimate enabler.

sections.title: Pictos & Lumina
sections.content:
Core Pictos for Verso

PictosEffectWhy
Painted PowerRemoves damage capMandatory once available
Energising Start I-IVBonus AP at fight startMore skills = faster S-Rank
Energising TurnAP each turnSustains expensive skill rotation
Energising ParryAP on successful ParryVerso Parries constantly — free AP
Full StrengthFlat damage increaseDirect multiplier at S-Rank
Warming UpDamage increases per turnPerfect for long boss fights
FrenzyDamage boostFrom Licornapieds in Verso's Draft

Priority Luminas

  • Energising Start (all tiers): Extra AP lets Verso reach S-Rank faster on turn one
  • Energising Parry: Verso's playstyle demands perfect defense — get rewarded for it
  • AP Discount: Reduces skill costs, letting Verso chain more abilities per turn
  • Augmented Counter I-III: Parry counterattacks deal massive damage while building Perfection

Dualiso-Specific Luminas

  • Enfeebling Attack
  • Combo Attack I
  • Energising Attack I
  • Greater Defenceless

sections.title: Build Strategies & Team Composition
sections.content:
Strategy 1: S-Rank Rush (Gaulteram)

Goal: Reach S-Rank within 2-3 turns and stay there permanently.

  • Turn 1: Light Holder + Assault Zero to push to A/S-Rank
  • Turn 2+: Phantom Stars, Strike Storm, or Follow Up for sustained S-Rank damage
  • Defense: Parry everything. One hit drops your Rank and your damage.

Strategy 2: Double Action (Dualiso)

Goal: Use the double-turn to build AND nuke in the same cycle.

  • First action: Multi-hit Rank builders (Light Holder, Assault Zero)
  • Second action: High-damage finisher (Phantom Stars, End Bringer on stunned targets)
  • Advantage: Reach S-Rank faster due to double the actions per cycle

Strategy 3: Team Amplifier (Sireso)

Goal: Maximize the damage of your actual DPS character.

  • Build to S-Rank with multi-hit attacks (benefit goes to allies, not self)
  • Maintain S-Rank while spamming Powerful (party buff) and Marking Shot
  • Best paired with: Maelle (Sword Ballet nuke), Sciel (Twilight AoE)

Team Compositions

  • Verso + Maelle + Lune: Verso marks, Maelle nukes with Sword Ballet, Lune heals and applies Burn.
  • Verso + Sciel + Gustave: Verso buffs with Powerful, Sciel deals Twilight AoE, Gustave applies Marks and Overcharge bursts.
  • Verso (Sireso) + Maelle + Sciel: Ultimate damage comp. Verso amplifies everyone while both DPS characters unleash their full potential.

Key Tips

  • Verso gains more Perfection from Critical Hits — Luck is his most valuable attribute after Might.
  • He deals Physical and Light damage natively. Equip a weapon with a different element (like Gaulteram) for better coverage.
  • Verso can apply Burn with Follow Up but cannot do so with any base skill — pair with Lune or Maelle for Burn synergies.
  • Perfect Recovery is your emergency button — heals AND dispels negative effects in one action.
